title: The Best of San Diego: Private Walking Tour including USS Midway
includes: A friendly, professional private tour guide
Plenty of time to take photos of your favourite places
A light pastry and coffee/soft drink
Hotel pickup, we do recommend a centrally located start point (not included)
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Enjoy a privately guided tour of America’s Finest City, with a snack, coffee, and tickets included to the USS Midway Museum. First, your guide will take you on a walking tour of several of San Diego’s many neighbourhoods, including historic Little Italy, the Gaslamp District, and Seaport Village. You will also get to see several of the city’s main attractions, including the Santa Fe Depot, and Petco Park. Enjoy a light snack and coffee along the route, while learning about the food scene in the city. Your tour finishes with tickets to the USS Midway, where you will enjoy the self-guided audio tour!
